(1) Yajñapārśva kārya[?], the 2nd pariśiṣṭa, ff.1-18: (2) Yūpalakṣaṇa, the 1st pariśiṣṭa, ff.1-2: (3) Chāgalakṣaṇa, f.1: (4) Ukthaśāstra [y interlinear] the 12th pariśiṣṭa, f.1: (5) Karmalakṣaṇa, the 18th pariśiṣṭa, f.1: (6) Utthānavidhi, the 17th pariśiṣṭa, f.1: (7) Mūlādhyāya, or Dakṣiṇādānaśaktau(?) mūlyavicāra, f.1, in different hand, scribe Gadādhara: (8) Iṣṭakāsaṃkhyā, ff.1-4: (9) Pārṣada, ff.1-9: (10) Gṛhyasūtra kṣepaka[?], ff.1-5 : (11) Nigama, the 14th pariśiṣṭa, ff.1-13 : (12) Kratusaṃkhyā, ff.1-4: (13) Ṛgyajuḥ, ff.10-13
                    n.d: 65: 7: D.
